prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. One finished landscape 3:2 full-bleed picture-book illustration, one coherent scene and moment, no panels or contact sheet. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-KIT / Kit: six-year-old human boy, golden light-medium skin, short straight black side-parted hair, teal T-shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. WD-ZOE / Zoe: six-year-old human girl, deep brown skin, black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt, plum overalls, white sneakers. Kit and Zoe have equal standing height. Include only characters needed by this exact scene, not every reference pose. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: More Than the Builder; World Discovery; fiction.
Setting: Empty classroom rehearsal corner, afternoon. Peach wall, blue-framed window left, bare wall shelf right, solid blue rug on tan floor. Only Kit and Zoe are visible in this close view.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): Plain cardboard puppet theater; Blue cloth curtain; Orange fox hand puppet; White rabbit hand puppet with one small brown-painted front paw, visible whenever that paw is raised; Two plain wooden stools; One supplied cardboard scenery panel with a simple brown den doorway drawn on it, placed behind the stage window from page 2 onward
 Input references lock identity, prop design and location; compose a NEW image for the exact scene, never reproduce the reference-board layout. The reference and overall prop list may contain finished objects and later story events: these are DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY, not permission to show them now. Show only the people, objects and development stage required below.
Page 10. Printed prose (NOT text to put in art): Zoe’s rabbit raises one muddy paw. Behind the curtain, Kit nearly laughs. The stage holds up, and so does his fox voice.
Required illustration: Fox and rabbit puppets share the window, rabbit’s brown-painted paw lifted; Kit and Zoe are partly visible behind the side curtain. Exact continuity: Muddy mark is puppet paint, not wet mud; stage intact and Kit performing, closing both roles.
Exact current state: Muddy mark is puppet paint, not wet mud; stage intact and Kit performing, closing both roles.
Do not add later events, duplicate props or a separate inset. No written title; the app renders live text.
All surfaces are smooth flat solid colors with limited cel shade. No fine texture, noise, paper grain, woodgrain or carpet fibers. Preserve the NEW reference theater geometry and puppet designs. Close view of the two puppets and a little of the children behind the side curtain; no audience in this framing. Rabbit raises its LEFT paw with the small brown painted patch. Kit nearly laughs while operating fox. Puppets do not float, hands support them from below; no extra hands or duplicate puppets.

visualReview.note: Payoff close framing: rabbit anatomical-left marked paw raised, Kit nearly laughing, stable stage and puppets.
visualReview.limits: Direct agent image/sequence inspection; not physical classroom observation.
